goal: Verify that a user can successfully register as a Site Host, create a standard memo, and create a second memo that includes a hashtag tag.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text area with the placeholder 'Any thoughts...' and click the 'Save' button.
In the same text area, type 'Meeting notes for #team-sync' and click the 'Save' button again.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and navigated to the main dashboard view after account creation.
The first memo containing the text 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' appears in the feed.
The second memo containing 'Meeting notes for #team-sync' appears in the feed.
The hashtag '#team-sync' in the second memo is rendered as a clickable tag element.
The 'Tags' section in the sidebar updates to display the new '#team-sync' tag.
